entries.input: What deductions are applied to my salary?
entries.output: {"answer": "The company’s payment policy is governed by a monthly payroll cycle (Section 7.3). Employees are paid once per month and the net salary is credited to their bank account after all applicable deductions, with the payment due by the last working day of the month (unless banking, holidays, or payroll processing delays apply). If an underpayment occurs, it will be corrected through the standard payroll process.", "citations": [{"section": "Policy", "source": "NEXORA TECHNOLOGIES PVT.docx", "text": "Depending on the employee's circumstances and applicable law, deductions may include: Income tax Provident fund contributions Professional tax Other statutory deductions Employees are responsible for providing accurate information required for payroll and tax processing. The company will apply statutory deductions based on the information and declarations available through the applicable payroll process."}, {"section": "Policy", "source": "NEXORA TECHNOLOGIES PVT.docx", "text": "Deductions may include legally required or authorized amounts such as: Income tax Employee provident fund contributions Other statutory contributions Approved employee deductions Recoveries authorized under applicable policies The difference between gross and net salary may therefore vary between employees. 7.7 Statutory Deductions Nexora makes deductions required under applicable laws and regulations."}, {"section": "Policy", "source": "NEXORA TECHNOLOGIES PVT.docx", "text": "7.16 Unpaid Leave Deduction When an employee takes approved Unpaid Leave, the corresponding salary deduction will generally be calculated based on the employee's applicable payroll rules and the number of unpaid days. The deduction may appear in the payslip for the month in which the unpaid absence is processed. Where payroll processing prevents the deduction from being applied in the same month, the adjustment may appear in a subsequent payroll cycle."}, {"section": "Policy", "source": "NEXORA TECHNOLOGIES PVT.docx", "text": "Depending on eligibility and applicable legislation, these may include: Provident Fund contributions Professional tax Statutory insurance or social security contributions Other legally required benefits The amount and treatment of statutory contributions may vary depending on an employee's circumstances and applicable regulations. Employees should contact Payroll or People & Culture for questions regarding statutory deductions or contributions."}], "session_id": "faq-seeder"}

entries.input: Can I carry forward unused annual leave?
entries.output: {"answer": "Eligible employees receive **10 days of Sick Leave each calendar year** (from 1 January to 31 December). This leave can be used for illness, medical appointments, rest after medical advice, or inability to perform normal duties. Employees should inform their manager as soon as reasonably possible if they cannot work due to illness.", "citations": [{"section": "Policy", "source": "NEXORA TECHNOLOGIES PVT.docx", "text": "Employees joining during the year receive a prorated entitlement. 19.2 Can I carry forward unused Annual Leave? Unused Casual Leave normally expires at the end of the calendar year and cannot normally be carried forward. 19.4 Do I need approval before taking leave? Yes."}, {"section": "Policy", "source": "NEXORA TECHNOLOGIES PVT.docx", "text": "Approval is subject to business requirements and team availability. 5.4 Annual Leave Carry-Forward Employees may carry forward unused Annual Leave into the following calendar year. Example: An employee has 14 unused Annual Leave days on 31 December."}, {"section": "Policy", "source": "NEXORA TECHNOLOGIES PVT.docx", "text": "5.10 Sick Leave Carry-Forward Unused Sick Leave does not normally carry forward to the following calendar year. entries.input: What is the company code of conduct?
entries.output: {"answer": "The Code of Conduct requires employees to behave in a respectful, non‑harassing manner at all times.  It prohibits intimidation, threats, humiliation, abusive or disruptive behaviour in verbal, written, electronic or social settings, and it forbids unlawful discrimination.  Violations can lead to a range of disciplinary actions—from counselling or warnings to suspension or termination—depending on the seriousness and impact of the behaviour.", "citations": [{"section": "Policy", "source": "NEXORA TECHNOLOGIES PVT.docx", "text": "17.5 Serious Misconduct Serious misconduct may result in significant disciplinary action, including termination of employment, subject to applicable law and company procedures. entries.input: What is the remote work policy?
entries.output: {"answer": "The remote‑work policy requires employees to work from a location that has been approved by the company and to maintain a secure, suitable environment that lets them perform their duties effectively.  Employees must keep themselves available during scheduled working hours, attend all required meetings, and protect confidential company and client information.  The arrangement can end if the employee requests a return to the office, changes roles, moves to a role that needs office presence, if business requirements change, or if the approval expires. entries.input: What is the sick leave entitlement?
entries.output: {"answer": "Eligible employees receive **10 days of Sick Leave each calendar year** (from 1 January to 31 December). This leave can be used for illness, medical appointments, rest after medical advice, or inability to perform normal duties. Employees should inform their manager as soon as reasonably possible if they cannot work due to illness.", "citations": [{"section": "Policy", "source": "NEXORA TECHNOLOGIES PVT.docx", "text": "5.8 Sick Leave Eligible employees receive 10 days of Sick Leave per calendar year. Sick Leave may be used when an employee is: Ill or recovering from an illness. Attending a medical appointment. Required to rest following medical advice. Unable to perform their normal duties due to illness. Employees should inform their reporting manager as soon as reasonably possible when they are unable to work due to illness."}, {"section": "Policy", "source": "NEXORA TECHNOLOGIES PVT.docx", "text": "Employees are expected to use leave responsibly and follow the applicable approval and documentation procedures. Leave entitlements may vary depending on an employee's employment category, length of service, and applicable law. Unless otherwise specified, leave is calculated based on the calendar year from 1 January to 31 December."}, {"section": "Policy", "source": "NEXORA TECHNOLOGIES PVT.docx", "text": "6.15 Remote Work During Illness Employees who are unwell but capable of working may request temporary Work From Home where permitted by their role and manager. Employees who are unable to work due to illness should use the applicable Sick Leave process rather than treating remote work as a substitute for leave. Working remotely while sick does not remove the employee's right to use eligible Sick Leave."}, {"section": "Policy", "source": "NEXORA TECHNOLOGIES PVT.docx", "text": "5.10 Sick Leave Carry-Forward Unused Sick Leave does not normally carry forward to the following calendar year.
